source_policy: Only official AWS HTTPS pricing/API sources and public regional Price List offers; no credentials or account APIs.

ec2.basis: Published billing is for compute, storage, transfer and optional features; these selected metadata Describe requests provision and consume none of those priced resources. Zero incremental request fee is an explicit estimate inference, not a provider promise.

elbv2.basis: Published meters cover running load-balancer hours/capacity units and data transfer; metadata Describe operations do not create a load balancer or send traffic through it. Zero incremental request fee is an explicit inference.

rds.basis: Published meters cover database compute, storage, backup and I/O; selected Describe operations read management metadata, not SQL/Data API queries, backup creation or restoration. Zero incremental request fee is an explicit inference.

ecs.basis: Published pricing covers infrastructure/capacity used for workloads; describing existing clusters/services does not launch tasks or provision capacity. Zero incremental metadata-request fee is an explicit inference.

eks.basis: Published EKS meters include cluster/capability/node hours; DescribeCluster does not create or extend a separate cluster. Zero incremental metadata-request fee is an explicit inference.

autoscaling.basis: AWS Auto Scaling itself has no additional charge; underlying resources and monitoring are separate. Describing an existing group creates neither.

iam.basis: IAM is available without an additional service charge; these GetRole/GetInstanceProfile operations do not invoke paid IAM Access Analyzer features.

lambda.basis: Published function request meters concern invocation/execution, with separate duration/provisioning/resource meters. Selected Get/List management operations do not invoke a function or provision event pollers. Zero incremental management-request fee is an explicit inference.

dynamodb.basis: Published read/write meters concern table-item data and streams; selected DescribeTable/DescribeContinuousBackups are management metadata reads, not item reads, backup creation or restore. Zero incremental management-request fee is an explicit inference.

dynamodb_control.basis: AWS distinguishes management control-plane operations such as DescribeTable from item-data reads/writes. This distinction scopes the pricing-meter inference.

route53.basis: Published meters cover hosted zones, DNS queries, health checks and optional features. Listing record metadata is neither a DNS resolution nor creation of a separately billed resource. Zero incremental management-request fee is an explicit inference.

s3.basis: S3 request charges depend on request type. The public regional GET-and-all-other request dimension supplies the us-east-1 rate; free tiers and discounts are deliberately excluded.

s3_versioning_api.basis: General-purpose GetBucketVersioning uses HTTP GET against the bucket versioning subresource, not an object retrieval.

s3_tagging_api.basis: General-purpose GetBucketTagging uses HTTP GET against the bucket tagging subresource, not an object retrieval.

sqs.basis: Every SQS action counts as a request. The selected Standard-queue attribute request is assumed at most64KiB and therefore one request unit; free monthly requests and volume discounts are excluded.

rate.description: $0.004 per 10,000 GET and all other requests

s3_tariff.basis: Published us-east-1 OnDemand first paid request tier; no free tier, volume discount, tax or transfer allocation.

rate.description: $0.40 per million Amazon SQS standard requests in Tier1 in US East (N Virginia)

sqs_tariff.basis: Published us-east-1 OnDemand first paid request tier; no free tier, volume discount, tax or transfer allocation.
